title: Unlabeled Debiasing in Downstream Tasks via Class-wise Low Variance Regularization

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the balanced accuracy of adversarial probes (two-layer fully connected networks) trained to predict binary gender from the model's embeddings on the BIOS (occupation prediction) and PAN16 (mention detection) datasets.

Measuring the balanced accuracy of adversarial probes trained to extract racial information (African American vs. White American) from the model's embeddings on the FDCL18 (hate speech detection) dataset.
Measuring the balanced accuracy of adversarial probes trained to predict five distinct age classes from the model's embeddings on the PAN16 multi-attribute mention detection dataset.
